prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions consistently overstated gains overall, though several winning updates (such as copy, hint, and redesign changes) performed better than predicted.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path redesign, finish copy, finish notification, home hint, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, and sign_in new_flow because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) remained effective, winning in 3 of 5 tests (+9.3%, +5.6%, and +4.3%).
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 2 of 7 tests (+4.2% and +3.9%), while the remaining 5 showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
No clear positive effect was seen across tests for choose_path layout, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, home notification, and sign_in hint.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Feed and Care Practice Flow: Adds an interactive feeding and basic care sandbox flow on the home intro screen so users can practice feeding and interacting with their pet before completing setup. (why: Interactive finish flows performed strongly in past tests (+9.3%, +5.6%, +4.3%), and support emails report confusion about how to care for and interact with pets after onboarding.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Audio and Animation Status Display: Adds real-time status indicators showing rendering progress, audio asset packing, and desktop display readiness on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait median time is 201s with long mean delays, and support emails mention pets failing to launch on desktop. Explaining exact generation steps lowers abandonment.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Account Pet Preservation Value Copy: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to stress that signing in protects pet custom progress and prevents accidental account resets. (why: 8 users wrote support emails regarding missing pets after signing in. Clear sign-in copy reassures users about account pet safety.)
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Rendering Interactive Sound & Visual Customizer Flow: Adds an interactive ambient sound and color preference selector while waiting for pet generation to complete. (why: Home wait step takes median 201s / mean 2336s. Giving users an interactive mini customizer during wait increases completion and reduces perceived wait time.)
4: [finish, copy] Quick Desktop Control & Summon Keyboard Shortcuts Copy: Updates body and button copy on home intro to explicitly list key shortcuts for hiding, summoning, and moving the pet. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion post-onboarding regarding hiding or interacting with the pet.)
5: [adoption, wait_info] Character Adoption Certificate Seal Status Info: Adds verification status copy and processing visual indicator on the adoption certificate screen to confirm pet registration progress. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (65.8%). Clear certification progress details build trust before rendering starts.)
6: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Companion Interaction Mode Guidance Hint: Adds dynamic hint copy on choose_path explaining how active vs quiet companion paths impact screen presence. (why: Choose_path has a high mean duration (514s), indicating users deliberate without clear guidance on what path options entail.)

scores.note: Interactive finish flows consistently perform well (+3.2% avg, wins up to +9.3%) and direct support mail supports this issue.
Home wait step has very long mean duration and pet launch emails, though wait_info only succeeded in 2 of 7 past tests.
Target step loses 27.1% of users with clear support complaints, but sign_in copy changes historically yielded -1.4% relative lift.
Home wait step is long and home new_flow historically gained +2.2%, but requires building interactive screens.
Support mail points to confusion, but finish copy changes underperformed in prior testing (-3.4%).
Adoption has highest drop-off (34.2%), but adoption interventions overall consistently hurt performance in past tests.
Easy config change to address long choose_path duration (514s mean), but hint changes show mixed historical results.
